truthReview: 2026-10-01: opened. Decision and analysis in the paper The CLI Is Already There (guerrilla.barkpark.cloud/papers/the-cli-is-already-there), linked from C086. Nothing delivered yet. S1 delivered 2026-10-01: shell-environment.js probes the login shell with a bounded time per candidate, merges its PATH ahead of the inherited one, falls back to launchctl (macOS) or the registry (Windows), and feeds provider runs, the sign-in worker, owned workers and the terminal; the main process PATH stays as launched. Unit cases: merge order, a hung shell skipped within budget, a shell that rejects -ilc, launchctl and registry fallbacks, parsers, the singleton. Live: an Electron app launched with the system PATH and a fixture login shell finds a fixture Claude Code and reports signed in, with its own PATH unchanged. One Mac; fixtures, not a real shell.
